description: Find destination pages ads drive to — what users call 'landing pages'. Filter by pageTypes (offer_page, advertorial, listicle, quiz, lead_capture, homepage, pdp, collection, blog, marketplace, app_store, social_profile) and by the technologies detected on the site, e.g. Shopify or Klaviyo. `search` is semantic over the page's title and description. Fields the user's Replo plan doesn't include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic); `lockedCount` is how many more results a higher plan shows. Say the data is on a higher plan; never estimate it yourself. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same call, to get the next page. Keep every other argument the same.

limit.description: Results per page: 20 by default, up to 40. Use the user's number when they give one; for more than 40, page with cursor.

pageTypes.description: CSV of landing-page types: offer_page,advertorial,listicle,quiz,lead_capture,homepage,pdp,collection,blog,marketplace,app_store,social_profile. The stored names product, squeeze and other still work.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_site_pages
title: Find landing pages
